wx-search-cli v0.1.0
Search and read WeChat official account (公众号) articles via Sogou WeChat search.

Usage:
  wx-search-cli search <query> [--page <n>]            Search articles, one page (JSON to stdout)
  wx-search-cli search-all <query> [--max-pages <n>]   Search with auto pagination (JSON to stdout)
  wx-search-cli content <real_url> [--referer <url>]   Fetch article body text (plain text to stdout)

Options:
  --page <n>        Page number for search (default: 1)
  --max-pages <n>   Max pages for search-all (default: 10)
  --referer <url>   Referer header for content, typically the "link" field from search results
  -h, --help        Show this help
  -v, --version     Show version

Examples:
  wx-search-cli search "人工智能"
  wx-search-cli search "人工智能" --page 2
  wx-search-cli search-all "人工智能" --max-pages 3
  wx-search-cli content "https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?src=11&..." --referer "https://weixin.sogou.com/link?..."
